story.conflict: A wife must separate compassion for her husband's unemployment from accepting a false household income funded by her own savings.
story.hook: Her husband admitted the salary he'd brought home was her own savings. He'd let her celebrate a job he hadn't found.
story.like_cta: LIKE IF SHE DESERVED THE TRUTH
story.premise: A husband admits that the salary from his supposed new job is money he has secretly taken from his wife's savings.
story.punchline: This time, Megan knew where the lunch was going.
story.script: Megan had packed his lunch every morning for six weeks. Now she asked where he'd been taking it. Paul said the library. He was still applying for jobs. She'd checked her savings because the car needed repairing. Two withdrawals matched the twelve hundred dollars he'd sent her as his share of the bills. Megan had thanked him for helping them get back on their feet. He said he'd wanted her to stop worrying. She asked how spending her emergency money without telling her was supposed to do that. Paul said he'd expected to find something before the next payday. Then he could put it back. Megan asked whether the dinner they'd had to celebrate the job came from the same savings. It had. He said he'd been ashamed to tell her he'd failed another interview. Megan said she'd married somebody who could be unemployed. She hadn't agreed to budget around an income he was inventing. Paul asked whether she wanted him to leave. She said she wanted the truth before another promise. They sat down with the bills and counted only the salary she actually earned. That didn't replace the money or settle what she'd trust him with next. The following morning, Paul picked up his lunchbox. He said he was going to the library to apply for three jobs. This time, Megan knew where the lunch was going.
story.twist: His effort to hide being unemployed has depleted the emergency fund while making her believe their finances were recovering.

youtube.description: A wife learns that her husband's celebrated new salary was coming from her own emergency savings.
youtube.title: The Lunchbox From the Job He Didn't Have

story.conflict: A father must acknowledge years of absence without accepting an organ donation as the price of rebuilding a relationship with his son.
story.hook: A groom banned his father from the wedding for refusing to donate a kidney. The kidney was supposed to go to the stepfather who'd raised him.
story.like_cta: LIKE IF AN INVITATION ISNT A BARGAIN
story.premise: A groom bans his father from the wedding because he refuses to donate a kidney to the stepfather who raised him.
story.punchline: For that morning, Rob needed a lift, and David had come.
story.script: David had already bought the cufflinks his son had chosen. Now Leo told him not to bring them or himself. His stepfather, Rob, had been there for school plays, broken bikes, and all the years David missed. Leo said David could finally give something back. David said he knew he'd been absent. He couldn't promise a kidney because he wanted a place in the photographs. Leo said that sounded like another excuse. David said he was afraid of the operation. He wasn't donating. Leo told him Rob hadn't been afraid of raising somebody else's child. David didn't argue with what Rob had done. He said it still didn't make his body something he owed the family. The call ended there. That evening, Rob rang him. He hadn't known about the condition attached to the wedding. Leo was frightened, he said, but Rob wasn't asking David to buy an invitation. David asked whether somebody was taking him to his appointments. Rob said Leo usually did, but the wedding preparations were getting difficult. David offered a lift on Tuesday. Rob asked whether he'd expect Leo to change his mind in return. David said no. On Tuesday, the cufflinks were still in their box. David drove to Rob's house instead. They had plenty they hadn't said to each other. For that morning, Rob needed a lift, and David had come.
story.twist: The stepfather did not ask for the wedding condition and does not want his illness turned into a bargain between father and son.

youtube.description: A father is excluded from his son's wedding over a kidney donation, then speaks to the stepfather at the center of the demand.
youtube.title: The Cufflinks Beside the Car Keys

story.conflict: A customer must refuse a false account without accepting the mechanic's claim that accountability would destroy his son's future.
story.hook: A mechanic wanted a customer to say she'd caused the damage his son had done. He called it giving a young man a second chance.
story.like_cta: LIKE IF SECOND CHANCES START WITH TRUTH
story.premise: A mechanic asks a customer to claim responsibility for damage his apprentice son caused, calling it a second chance for the young man.
story.punchline: His father read it without changing the name.
story.script: Rina had left the car for a service. Now the front panel was crumpled, and the mechanic, Gary, asked her to say it happened after collection. His apprentice stood beside the damaged headlight. Gary said the boy was his son, Ben, and one mistake shouldn't follow him forever. Rina asked why that meant the mistake had to become hers. Gary said an account from the owner would make things simpler. She asked for whom. Ben started to speak, but Gary told him to fetch the keys. Rina asked Ben whether he'd been driving. He said he'd hit a pillar while moving the car. Gary said they'd already discussed what to tell her. Ben looked at his father and said he didn't want her blamed. Rina told Gary she wasn't agreeing to a false story. The repair needed arranging, and Ben needed somebody to explain what should happen when he made a mistake. Gary said she was lecturing him about his own child. Rina said he was asking a stranger to carry the consequences so his child wouldn't have to learn. Gary looked at the broken headlight. He said the workshop would repair it. Ben asked whether he should write down what happened. Gary reached for the pad, then let his son take it. Ben wrote that he'd been driving. His father read it without changing the name.
story.twist: The son is ready to admit the accident, but his father treats covering it up as the way to protect him.

youtube.description: A mechanic asks a customer to cover for his son after an accident, but the son wants a different kind of second chance.
youtube.title: The Name Under the Broken Headlight

story.conflict: Newlyweds and another guest must reject a hotel manager's attempt to sell the same private room as separate beds.
story.hook: A bride found a stranger unpacking in her honeymoon suite. He had a key and a booking for the spare bed.
story.like_cta: LIKE IF PRIVATE MEANS THE ROOM
story.premise: A bride finds a stranger booked into the spare bed of the honeymoon suite she and her husband reserved as private.
story.punchline: Nobody else had a booking for it.
story.script: Lena was opening the complimentary chocolates when the door unlocked. A man walked in with a suitcase and apologized. He thought she'd been given his room. Her husband, Adam, showed him their booking: private honeymoon suite. The man, Neil, showed them his: private single, assigned bed two in the same suite. He'd thought the receptionist meant a separate bedroom. They called the manager. He said the king bed belonged to the newlyweds and the spare bed belonged to Neil. Lena asked why a stranger had a key to their private room. The manager said their bed was private. Adam asked whether somebody else could book their bathroom too. The manager said there was no reason adults couldn't be reasonable. Neil said he'd paid for a private room, not a place in somebody else's honeymoon. The manager offered to put up a screen between the beds. Lena asked whether the screen came with a door and a lock. It didn't. They'd booked one night in their own city before leaving for their honeymoon the next morning. Adam said they were going home. Neil told the manager he could keep that room only if it became the private room he'd paid for. The manager finally canceled the couple's charge and gave Neil the room alone. At home, Lena put the chocolates between two cups of tea. They had a spare bed there too. Nobody else had a booking for it.
story.twist: The stranger also expected privacy, while the manager claims that the couple were promised a private bed rather than a private room.

youtube.description: A hotel's honeymoon upgrade comes with a stranger in the spare bed and a manager arguing that only the couple's bed was promised as private.
youtube.title: The Other Booking in the Honeymoon Suite
